concepts.title: Angle basics
concepts.description: Classify an angle by its measure rather than by drawn ray length

concepts.title: Angle pairs
concepts.description: Relate complementary, supplementary, and vertical angle pairs

concepts.title: Triangle angle sum

concepts.title: Triangle classification
concepts.description: Classify triangles by side lengths and by interior angles

concepts.title: Polygon perimeter
concepts.description: Add boundary lengths to find the distance around a figure

concepts.title: Rectangle area
concepts.description: Find area as a count of unit squares in rows and columns

concepts.title: Triangle area
concepts.description: Relate a triangle to half of an enclosing rectangle

concepts.title: Composite area
concepts.description: Decompose a compound figure into rectangles and triangles

concepts.title: Pythagorean theorem
concepts.description: Relate the squares of the legs to the square of the hypotenuse

concepts.title: Circle measures
concepts.description: Find circumference and area from a radius using a stated value of pi
